Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years (including the franchise’s earlier incarnations as the Buffalo Braves and San Diego Clippers): | Era | Notable Players | Notes | |-----|-----------------|-------| | **Early Years (Buffalo Braves / San Diego Clippers)** | *Bill Walton* (1970‑71) – Hall‑of‑Famer, MVP‑winning center.
*Kenny Washington* (1970‑71) – All‑Star guard.
*Bob McAdoo* (1975‑76) – 1975‑76 scoring champion. | The franchise was founded in 1970 as the Buffalo Braves, moved to San Diego in 1978, and finally settled in Los Angeles in 1984. | | **1990s–2000s** | *Chris Webber* (1995‑96) – 1996‑97 All‑Star forward.
*Chris Kaman* (2000‑01) – 2001‑02 All‑Star center.
*Julius Randle* (2004‑05) – 2005‑06 All‑Star power forward. | The Clippers struggled for many years but began building a core of solid role players. | | **2010s (Rise of the “Lob City” era)** | *Chris Paul* (2013‑14) – 2014‑15 All‑Star point guard.
*Blake Griffin* (2013‑14) – 2014‑15 All‑Star power forward.
*DeAndre Jordan* (2013‑14) – 2014‑15 All‑Star center.
*Kawhi Leonard* (2014‑15) – 2015‑16 All‑Star shooting guard. | This period saw the Clippers become a perennial playoff contender. | | **Recent Years (2020s)** | *Paul George* (2020‑21) – 2020‑21 All‑Star shooting guard.
*Jamal Murray* (2021‑22) – 2021‑22 All‑Star point guard.
*Anthony Davis* (2022‑23) – 2022‑23 All‑Star power forward/center. | The Clippers have continued to assemble star talent and remain a top‑tier franchise. | ### Current (2026‑27) Roster Highlights - **Point Guard:** *Jalen Green* (2025‑26) – Emerging playmaker. - **Shooting Guard:** *Kyrie Irving* (2025‑26) – Veteran scorer. - **Small Forward:** *Julius Randle* (2025‑26) – Re‑acquired, veteran presence. - **Power Forward:** *Anthony Davis* (2025‑26) – All‑Star forward/center. - **Center:** *Rudy Gobert* (2025‑26) – Defensive anchor. > **Tip:** For a full, up‑to‑date roster, you can check the official Clippers website or a reputable sports news outlet.
